headline: Echoback Landing
title: Echoback Landing | Water Beach Region | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Echoback Landing is a pink sand beach where wild Aniimo run from level thirty six to forty. Most are Water types, like Shelly, Sheldon and Susuta, with Budclaw and Shrubclaw on the sand. Bring Grass or Lightning attackers, since both hit Water for one point six times damage. Thunderstorms also bring the Thunderstorm form of Sherro, so check the weather before you explore. What do you catch first? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Echoback Landing guide: wild levels 36-40, mostly Water types (Shelly, Sheldon, Susuta) plus Budclaw and Shrubclaw. Use Grass or Lightning attackers.
